info.name: Microsoft SharePoint File Sync
info.summary: Download SharePoint / OneDrive folders recursively into a Nextcloud Group Folder
info.description:
Import files from a Microsoft SharePoint or OneDrive folder into Nextcloud, recursively, preserving the folder hierarchy.
Authenticate once with a single Microsoft account (Delegated OAuth) that already has access to the shared folders — no changes required on the client tenant. Point the app at a SharePoint folder URL, choose a destination Group Folder, and download everything below that folder with a single click from the admin panel.
**Features** - Delegated OAuth2 (authorization code flow) with a single service account, refresh token stored encrypted - Recursive download of a SharePoint / OneDrive folder and all its sub-folders - Destination inside a Nextcloud Group Folder (team folder), with the SharePoint path replicated idempotently (existing folders are reused, never duplicated) - Change detection by size and modification date to skip unchanged files on re-runs - Manual "Download now" trigger from the admin panel with a live progress report - Uses Nextcloud's built-in HTTP client — no external Composer dependencies
Developed by [IANUSTEC](https://ianustec.com) as part of our open-source initiative to help companies migrate from Google and Microsoft to self-hosted infrastructure.
info.author: IANUSTEC
